problem: The command reply can be ready before the frontend has consumed earlier FIFO configuration events. The strict frontend ready check may therefore refuse a valid manual choice.
reproduction: Actual SessionDeliveryFlow plus set/confirmation path reproduces setter reply ready -> consume old blocked -> confirmation reply ready -> consume later queued ready. Old implementation failed with state-not-ready; final implementation succeeds.
change: After confirmation reply, wait for the same existing delivery owner to finish a fresh normal pull/ACK pass within the original 30-second operation deadline, then retain every original owner/busy/status/snapshot/value check. No ready-reply overwrite, native change, new RPC or persistent ledger.
failureBoundaries: old in-flight null cannot substitute for a post-reply pass
deadline rejects this waiter without cancelling the Agent or releasing other pauses
buffered or deferred transport ACK does not prove business consumption
configuration guard and draft remain protected on refusal

nativeReuse.scope: Cargo fmt/clippy/test original successful receipts reused for unchanged native sources/dependencies/config; not a fresh native suite. Fresh production build separately embeds changed frontend.

causalityLimit: The reachable race and fix are proved by a red/green actual-flow regression. Two installed manual model choices, actual next generation and cold recovery passed; no body-level trace proves every historical failure had this timing.
